thread:
maria: Quick flag - discovered a dead link in the runbook: `/kb/dedicated/setup/ssh-access` returns 404 from staging. Hitting it from the 'dedicated bootstrap' tutorial.
sam: thanks for the report. Any idea which doc references it?
maria: The tutorial `dedicated/bootstrap.md` includes a shortlink on step 3. I reproduced with curl: `curl -I https://internal.kb/redwood/dedicated/setup/ssh-access` -> `HTTP/2 404`
dave: hmm, I remember we moved the SSH section under /dedicated/access last quarter. Might be an orphaned shortlink.
lee: I touched that area - will take it. Two options: add a 301 redirect in the redirects.yaml OR update the tutorial to point to the new path. Which do you prefer?
ellie: Redirect is preferred to preserve old links, but updating the tutorial is ok if redirecting requires infra change.
docs-bot: link-scan: detected 1 broken shortlink in /dedicated/bootstrap.md (approx line 45). Recommended: redirect entry OR update reference + PR note.
sam: If lee can do both (redirect + doc update) that's safest. Low-risk change.
lee: will open a small PR that adds a redirect entry to redirects.yaml and patches the tutorial inline. Will include the failing `curl -I` output and a short rationale.
maria: thanks, please add the staging reproduction steps so QA can verify.
dave: also please add an entry in the docs OWNERS file indicating who's covering the dedicated onboarding for the next sprint.
lee: PR opened: https://gh.redwood/repo/docs/pulls/5177 — adds redirect (301) from /redwood/dedicated/setup/ssh-access -> /redwood/dedicated/access/ssh and updates the tutorial. Commits have small tests.
ellie: reviewing now. tiny nit: include the original publish date in the redirect comment and mention the ticket that caused the move.
lee: good call, adding that note.
docs-bot: deploy-notice: docs site rebuild queued (PR 5177). ETA ~4m.
maria: verified staging after merge; redirect resolves and tutorial builds cleanly. Leaving a +1.
sam: LGTM from me. I'll run a repo-wide grep for similar `/dedicated/setup` shortlinks and open follow-ups if any.
dave: nice quick turnaround. @lee can you add yourself to OWNERS for dedicated onboarding for 14 days? helps triage any follow-ups.
lee: done 44d added to OWNERS and added a short note in the PR about the rota.
maria: thanks team. If anyone spots other broken shortlinks tag me and I'll triage in the docs small-fixes bucket.
ellie: great async flow — form followups in the bug board.
lee: closing loop here.
